items.title: A China stopover is not a round trip
items.caption:
Planning a visa-free stopover in China? A lot of people think it works like a round trip: fly in, then fly home. The transit rule needs an onward ticket to a third country or region — so plan it as home → China → a third country. US and Canadian passports are on the transit list. Entry rules as of Nov 16, 2026. Rules change, so confirm on the official NIA site before you book. Not visa or legal advice.

items.caption:

items.caption:

items.title: Your card in China: link it to a payment app
items.caption:
Will your card work in China like at home? Many think they'll just tap or swipe it. But mobile payments are widely used there: you scan a QR code. So before you fly, link your international credit card to a payment app — and keep a backup way to pay. Payment info as of Nov 16, 2026; confirm on official sites.
